results.title: The models listing with no ordering parameter
results.evidence: page one and page two share 1 row(s) after one registration between the two reads: ['maya://model/hc-b3676b18']. `/models` pages with LIMIT/OFFSET, so an insert that sorts before the boundary shifts every later row down and the last row of page one arrives again as the first of page two — the reader sees it twice and, symmetrically, a delete makes them miss one. `core/http/conventions.page` exists
